messages:
Maya (Design): quick find from usability: on compact density the toggle + inline tooltip on the feature flags page gets its touch area squished and a save toast overlaps the tooltip arrow. users on small phones can't reach the tooltip to read details before the toast covers it. gif attached.
Josh - Eng: repro steps? page/viewport?
Maya (Design): Settings -> Feature flags, narrow viewport ~360px, tap the small info tooltip next to the switch, then toggle the switch which triggers a toast saying 'Enabled'. the tooltip arrow sits under the toast and the tooltip content becomes unreadable.
Devon (Design Systems): likely culprits: compact alias reduced `--space-inline` and `--tooltip-padding` and we didn't preserve hit area for the tooltip trigger. also toasts are fixed-bottom and can overlap tooltips because we didn't reserve a safe zone for open interactive elements.
Priya (PM): product impact: users might miss important details about flags and mis-tap the toggle. copy "Enabled" is also ambiguous if multiple flags toggle concurrently. consider "Flag enabled: <name>".
Josh - Eng: short-term patch: when a tooltip is opened add `data-interactive-open` on body and nudge toasts up if overlapping that rect. also increase tooltip trigger hit area via css: `.tooltip-trigger { padding: 10px; margin: -10px; }` to preserve compact visuals but larger hit.
Devon (Design Systems): long-term: 1) add `--touch-target-min` token = 44px and document negative-margin pattern for visual density; 2) add `--protected-interactive-gap` so toasts keep at least half the touch-target away from viewport edges; 3) add a tokens linter to fail alias combinations that yield effective hit areas < token min.
Maya (Design): accessibility note: keyboard focus for tooltip trigger also gets hidden by toast. focus-visible should render above toasts or toasts should shift when focus enters nearby controls.
Priya (PM): copy nit agreed. for flags use contextual toast: "<flag name> enabled" and for disables "<flag name> disabled". add analytics event so we can surface which flags get frequent accidental toggles.
Josh - Eng: implemented quick fix on staging: tooltip trigger expanded, toast shifts up when `data-interactive-open` present. PR `tooltip-toast-avoid-1865` preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/pr/4123. CI green.
qa-bot: tested on iPhone SE + Pixel emulators. tooltip readable, toggle tap rate improved. left screenshots. added Percy snapshots for 320/375 viewports with tooltip open + toast.
Devon (Design Systems): follow-ups: add `--touch-target-min` to tokens README, add lint, and update compact aliases so visual density remains but hit areas preserved. also add a docs note about avoiding transforms on containers that host poppers.
Maya (Design): thanks all. small change but high impact for mobile clarity. Priya, can you review the contextual copy mapping?
Priya (PM): will post a short mapping later today. good catch everyone :thumbsup:
